verdict.rationale: Mercury's own docs show automatic duplicate detection, but only for bills in Bill Pay. The Command AI assistant answers on-demand questions about spend and trends grounded in account data. Nothing documents an agent that continuously monitors the Books ledger and proactively flags spend anomalies or duplicate ledger transactions before close, and the MCP/agent layer is only announced as 'soon'. Missing for 10: proactive agent monitoring of the ledger, spend-anomaly flagging, duplicate detection across ledger transactions (not just bills), a shipped agent/API/MCP access path, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent monitor the ledger and flag anomalies in spend or duplicate transactions before the close

citations.quote: Mercury automatically detects duplicate bills, giving you an extra set of eyes and preventing you from overpaying.
Ask Command anything about your finances — spend, trends, GL codes — and get immediate answers grounded in your account data
